column1: # Requirements proven by review, not by a test: the requirement, a tab, how it is verified.

column2: The VM end-to-end run (.github/workflows/e2e.yml, step "Install a VM end to end", tests/e2e/ci.sh -> tests/e2e/lib.sh install_server, network install on a 16 GB runner): boot serve downloads the netboot files and the live-server ISO, verifies each against src/archon-boot/pins.ts (it refuses to serve on a mismatch), caches them, and the blank VM PXE-boots from its TFTP (dnsmasq --dhcp-boot=bootx64.efi, next-server the boot server) and HTTP port 8080 until the event boot.ready; the run fails otherwise.
